title: Air Force Academy religious training

tellings.quote: I was appalled a couple of years ago to hear how the Air Force Academy uh in Colorado was training, you know, their people in in religious studies, right?

plain: The US Air Force Academy in Colorado has been training its people in religious studies, according to a researcher named Peter Levenda. He tells Michels he was appalled to hear of it a couple of years ago, and he names no source for what he heard.
